title: Chicken Caesar Salad
steps: Put the eggs in a small saucepan, cover with cold water and bring to the boil. Cook for 8 minutes, then cool under cold running water, peel and quarter.
Split each chicken breast in half horizontally so you have 4 thin fillets. Rub with a little olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Heat a chargrill pan or barbecue over medium-high heat. Grill the chicken for 3-4 minutes each side until cooked through. Rest for 5 minutes, then slice thickly.
While the chicken rests, fry the bacon rashers in the same pan until crisp. Drain on paper towel and roughly chop.
Wash the baby cos, tear the leaves into large pieces and dry well. Toss the leaves in a large bowl with about half the caesar dressing.
Pile the dressed leaves onto plates. Top with the sliced chicken, bacon, egg quarters and croutons.
Scatter over the shaved parmesan, drizzle with the remaining dressing and grind over black pepper to serve.
